title: PluginUiTest report
description: The report written by PluginUiTest --json=<file>. Schema version 1: removing or renaming a field, or changing its meaning, raises schemaVersion; a new optional field does not. See docs/report.md.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the report's shape.

tool.description: The tool and its version, e.g. "PluginUiTest 0.2.0".

banner.const: Test tool, not affiliated with the Dalamud team, does not replace Dalamud.

note.description: Where Dalamud and the game data came from: nothing is redistributed.

plugin.description: The full path of the plugin DLL the user named.

facts.description: Header facts in English: frames, timeout, Dalamud folder and version, game data, plugin copy, configuration folder, window systems found.

result.description: The one-line summary printed last on the console.

exitCode.description: 0 every part drawn, hidden or skipped; 1 something threw, blocked or crashed; 2 usage or refusal; 3 the plugin could not be created.

fatal.description: Why the plugin could not be created (exit 3), else null.

entries.description: One entry per part, in the order they ran.

key.description: Unique key of the part: constructor, load (IAsyncDalamudPlugin.LoadAsync), framework:<Type.Method> (work handed to IFramework.RunOnFrameworkThread, RunOnTick or Run; #2, #3 when repeated), OpenMainUi:<Type.Method>, OpenConfigUi:<Type.Method>, window:<ImGui name>, draw:<Type.Method>.

kind.description: load and framework since 0.2.0 (schema version 1: values only added).

name.description: The window's name (with its ###id if any) or the handler's method.

outcome.description: drawn also means created (constructor) and ran (load, framework, OpenMainUi, OpenConfigUi).

label.description: The word the console and the markdown report show.

detail.description: Exception type and message, the crash, the block, or the game-memory finding.

where.description: The first frame of the plugin's own code in the exception's stack, or the call path to game memory.

frames.description: Frames run for the part (--frames); 0 when it did not draw (constructor, handlers, skipped).

vertices.description: The largest vertex count of one frame.

absent.description: Dalamud members reached through stand-ins that answer default values, and sheets asked without game data.

network.description: Network requests of the plugin, e.g. "blocked: GET https://example.com/".

logErrors.description: Errors the plugin wrote to its IPluginLog.
